source_annotation.prompt: Move the clock and place it into the transparent container.

generation_prompt: The robot uses the hand entering from the lower-right edge to close its thumb and fingers around the golden pastry on the tabletop, lifts it over the eyeglasses, and carries it across the rim of the transparent plastic container. It lowers the pastry inside, opens its hand to release it onto the container floor, then withdraws to the right, leaving the pastry resting in the container. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
